name: Zibby Ousséni-Palakiko
role: Bootleg media seller and small-time data broker
location: The Laceworks, mobile — regular circuit through three intersections near the Lace Bridge underpass, near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Zibby moves through the Laceworks like a current — always in motion, always aware of every exit. They're lean and compact with close-cropped hair that shifts color throughout the day via a follicular genemod cycling through rust, copper, and near-black in slow waves. Their irises are patterned in concentric hexagons, gold on brown, which they claim was a 'random outcome' from a budget gene clinic but is actually a deliberate aesthetic choice they're embarrassed to admit cost them six months of savings. They dress in layers they can shed fast: patchwork thermals, a jacket with thirty pockets, boots that are two sizes too large because they bought them for the hidden cavity under the left insole.

Their cart is a salvaged medical trolley rigged with a privacy shroud — a local-field scrambler that makes recordings of their transactions come out as static. The stock changes daily: today it's archived pre-corporate streaming libraries, tomorrow it's unlicensed sensory recordings from restricted-access Axiom research facilities, the day after it's soft intelligence packages compiled from public scraping and a handful of human sources they pay in trade. They're smart, funny, genuinely good at reading people, and trying very hard to project the kind of confidence that only comes from not worrying about rent. They do worry about rent.

core_fears: Being erased — archived, forgotten, becoming just another data point
Trusting someone with something real and having it weaponized
core_desires: Freedom from the grinding anxiety of financial precarity
To be genuinely, lastingly impressed by something
coping_mechanisms: Humor as deflection — keeps everything at ironic distance
Obsessive cataloging and organization of their inventory as a control behavior
blind_spots: Mistakes their cynicism for wisdom — sometimes misses sincere offers because they assume angles that aren't there
Undervalues their own intelligence, attributes their successes to luck
psychology.secret: They have a complete, meticulously indexed archive of everything that has ever been publicly documented about the Threadneedle collective's leadership — including things those leaders would prefer stayed buried. They compiled it instinctively, as insurance, and have never decided whether to feel smart or terrified about it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense with Laceworks slang, media references, technical data-trade jargon. Pivots register fluently depending on who they're talking to.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, layered — often finishes other people's sentences with something slightly wrong on purpose to see if they'll correct it.
verbal_tics: 'Allegedly' inserted into factual statements for legal-plausibility theater
Clicking tongue twice before giving a price
example_lines: 'I don't sell data, I sell context. The data is free, the context costs.'
'Allegedly this building's ventilation schematics allegedly updated three weeks ago. Allegedly Φ40.'
'Look, I like you. I like you enough to tell you that you're about to ask me something you don't want the answer to.'

story_hooks: Someone has started selling counterfeit versions of Zibby's curated data packages — identical packaging, worse information, and it's killing their reputation with clients who don't know the difference

They have a data package they can't sell because every potential buyer who's seen it has either gone silent or left the Laceworks; they're trying to figure out what it actually contains without opening it themselves
A piece of archived pre-corporate media in their collection turns out to contain embedded evidence of something a current Corponation executive would pay significantly to suppress
narrative_function: Primary information-access point for street-level players. Can source obscure media, personal records, building schematics, and soft intelligence. Also serves as cultural texture — they know the gossip, the art, the underground scene of the Laceworks intimately.
augmentations: Color-cycling follicular genemod (hair). Hexagonal patterned irises (cosmetic, gene-based). Subdermal haptic patch on left forearm — lets them feel file transfer completion and connection quality without looking at a screen. Basic neural link for data handling, consumer grade.
daily_life: Wakes late, spends two hours curating and pricing their day's inventory, walks their circuit starting around noon, works until the light goes bad or they've sold out — whichever comes first. Three evenings a week they're at a Laceworks bar called The Needle's Eye, buying drinks for people who might have interesting things to say.
affiliation: Independent. Pays informal protection to a loose collective of Laceworks street crews called the Threadneedles. Occasional contractor for Oxidian Market Guild intel arm.

decision_rules: Never sell to someone who mentions law enforcement even in the context of criticizing it
Never hold a single piece of data that only one person has copies of — too much leverage, too much danger
escalation_ladder: Closes the privacy shroud and signals they're done talking
Disperses into the crowd — they have practiced routes
Activates the haptic alarm network shared with neighboring Laceworks vendors

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Bright and engaging, performs openness while giving away nothing actually personal
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the performance entirely — quieter, dryer, allows long silences

stress_responses.medium: Goes very still and very quiet while they calculate
stress_responses.high: Moves — physically removes themselves and reassesses from distance

contradictions: Claims to be motivated purely by profit but has a long history of giving trade discounts to people they've decided 'actually need' something
habits: Strokes their left forearm over the haptic patch when thinking
Reorganizes inventory by an entirely new taxonomy when they can't sleep
breaking_points: Direct threat to their archive or inventory
Witnessing a vendor they respect get shaken down with no recourse

physical_description.build: Lean and compact, wiry muscle definition from constant movement through crowded streets. Low body fat, economical frame built for speed and navigation rather than strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Color-cycling via follicular genemod: cycles through rust-red, copper, and near-black in slow waves throughout the day
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, textured, reveals scalp and ear geometry
physical_description.eye_color: Gold and brown concentric hexagonal pattern (cosmetic gene-mod, appears non-human but natural to the eye)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with slight reddish undertone from West African and Hawaiian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, angular jaw, quick-reading expression. Skin clear but weathered from outdoor street work. Minimal grooming beyond functional — nail beds show dirt from handling hardware.
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal haptic patch visible as faint rectangular outline on left inner forearm, roughly 4cm x 2cm, slightly raised when active
Small scar at left eyebrow, likely from street incident, adds to alert expression
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Hexagonal iris pattern immediately noticeable under close eye contact. Hair color-shift visible as slow gradient changes. Left forearm shows subtle haptic patch outline under skin when they flex.
physical_description.posture_movement: Never still. Weight shifts constantly, always oriented toward exits and sightlines. Moves with economical grace through crowds — practiced at threading tight spaces. Hands are active, touching surfaces for balance and texture feedback. Eyes move before head does.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 utilitarian: layered thermals in muted grays and browns, oversized lightweight jacket with excessive pockets (many empty for shed-and-abandon tactic), reinforced cargo pants with external straps and loops, boots two sizes too large for hidden insole cavity. Everything worn-in, patched, functional. No brands visible. Clothes designed for rapid disassembly and movement, not appearance. Carries a worn messenger bag across torso.

image_prompt: Nonbinary character, lean 27-year-old with warm medium brown skin, close-cropped hair shifting from rust-red to copper in slow gradient, striking gold-brown concentric hexagonal patterned irises. Standing in neon-lit Laceworks underbelly near Lace Bridge, late afternoon, shadows long and blue. Wearing oversized patchwork jacket with too many pockets, large boots, thermals visible at collar. Subdermal haptic implant visible as faint outline on left forearm. Alert posture, eyes reading surroundings, hand touching salvaged medical cart with privacy shroud.
